title: The Pyramids of Egypt: How They Were Built, What They Were For, and the Myths Around Them
author: Meechie's World Inc
blurb: Who really built the pyramids, how the stones were cut, moved and raised, what they were for, and what the latest discoveries show. 300 pages, with the myths checked against the evidence. Free PDF on the book's page.

title: From Harlem to Fort Dix: The Rise, the Reign, and the Reckoning of Sean "Diddy" Combs
author: Meechie's World Inc
blurb: From a little boy who lost his father in Harlem, to the top of the music business, to a federal prison in New Jersey. The full story, told straight, the way we tell stories on the block. 34 chapters, updated through October 2026, with about 600 sources.

title: Donald J. Trump: An Investigative Biography
author: Meechie's World Inc
blurb: Four indictments. Two impeachments. One felony conviction. And a comeback nobody saw coming. The paper trail of Donald J. Trump, from Queens to the second term, told from the public record.

title: Paper Trail: Jeffrey Epstein and the Fight for the Files
author: Meechie's World Inc
blurb: How the most protected man in America left a record he could not erase. Volume One, Part A: Front Matter and Chapters 1–5, from a Brooklyn boyhood to Leslie Wexner's right-hand man (1953–1996).

title: TikTok: The Opportunity — How Creators Build Audiences, Income, and Businesses
author: Meechie’s World Inc
blurb: A practical and honest guide to TikTok for people who want to use it to share a skill, grow a brand, sell something, or simply understand why it matters. Where the platform came from, how the recommendation system works, how creators earn, and how to plan, make, and read the numbers on videos. 297 pages.

title: Meechie’s World: The Story and the Blueprint
author: Meechie’s World Inc
blurb: The story of Meechie’s World Inc from facts the founder has shared, and the business lessons drawn from that work — radio, TV, books, and business, from Fairchance to the world. 298 pages.

title: Faith: The Foundation — Aliens, Witches, Uranium, and the Case for One God
author: Meechie’s World Inc
blurb: An independent book of faith and reflection from the author’s Muslim perspective — aliens, witches, uranium, and the case for one God, treating people of every faith, and of none, with respect. 297 pages.

title: SpaceX: The Mission — The People, the Technology, and the Next Frontier
author: Meechie’s World Inc
blurb: The people, the technology, and the next frontier — the story of SpaceX, from the early failures to the rockets that land themselves, told from public sources. 298 pages.
